caption: Baptistery of Pisa, Pisa
composition: Circular marble Romanesque-Gothic baptistery on the Piazza dei Miracoli lawn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the lawn before the Baptistery of Pisa, the great circular marble building filling the frame in the bright 13:43 midday sun. Tier upon tier of white arcades wrap the cylinder at center, the domed roof rising behind a crown of Gothic gables, and the green grass of the Piazza dei Miracoli stretches across the foreground. Town rooftops and cypress trees show at the left and right edges beneath a vivid blue sky.
